report.interpretation: Mechanism experiment only. A removed BUY is not automatically a correct trade; no account, fill, return or policy selection is recomputed. Trace removal changes future activity through online memory updates, so the offline algebraic split does not predict its causal effect.

selection: Most active 18 visual and 48 KC cells, identified DAN/MBON/output cells, plus requested IDs. Layout is grouped by function, not anatomical coordinates. Full graph simulated; full neuron traces in NPZ.

plastic_credit.interpretation: Earlier-image and current-image trace contributions sum to the observed learning drive before memory filtering and clipping. These are algebraic components with full recorded activity held fixed, not causal effects of images, dopamine pulses, trades, or removing traces. No gradients, neural simulation, trading returns, or policy promotion are computed.
